headline: Bitcoin Holds Above $63,750 Despite $300 Million ETF Outflows
summary: Bitcoin held above $63,750 even as spot Bitcoin ETFs registered more than $300 million in outflows on Wednesday amid ongoing Federal Reserve interest rate threats.
why: Bitcoin is the world's largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a primary benchmark for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin held key price support around $63,750 despite heavy daily institutional fund outflows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
